title: skills(objectstack-platform): the skill names the `push` key and capability but never teaches the push block's shape (transport, apns / fcm, credentialRef)
body:
domain:skills#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnMUWA9rufXzFaEh4J

Filing gate: ① a named-location teaching gap, owed as follow-up to already-landed work (PR #29968, card #29820). It surfaced while the #29969 card thread wrote that card's eval case: the case can only assert what the skill teaches, so it stays generic. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3.

reach: a named real producer. `PushServiceConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts`) is the stack's `push` key (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` ~L1136), and `PushServicePlugin` (`@objectstack/service-push`) is built from it.

## What the skill says (at `origin/main`)

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L42 lists `push` among the top-level keys.
- L310 maps the `requires` token `push` to `@objectstack/service-push`.
- Nothing teaches the block itself: the transport choice, the `apns` / `fcm` credentials by `credentialRef` (never inline), or which transports are served today. The hosted relay sender is #29920, still open.

## Wanted

- One short passage, in `SKILL.md` or a reference the skill routes to: what a `push` block carries, credentials by `credentialRef` only, and the relay transport's current status. Read the facts off `push-config.zod.ts` and `@objectstack/service-push` on main.
- Then extend #29969's eval case (`config-plugins-ops.json`) to assert the taught shape.
- Pay within the `check-skills-token-ratchet` ceiling by same-file deletion. `SKILL.md` has about 11 tokens of headroom after PR #30071, so a reference file may be the better home.

Business reason: an agent asked to turn on push for an `os serve` deployment learns from the skill that `push` exists, but not how to fill it. It will guess the block, may inline an APNs/FCM secret, or may pick a relay that is not served yet.

Reader who acts: the skills lane. `skills/**` is Tier H, so it needs `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` before landing.

Serial: after PR #30071 (the same `SKILL.md`).

Dedupe: searched `push skill objectstack-platform` (660 hits; the first pages hold only #29969 and unrelated platform-skill cards). **New.**
